topic: What antenna designs balance aerodynamic constraints with MIMO requirements for high-speed aircraft communication?
consensus_response: Compact MIMO designs with reduced inter-element spacing and phased array technology optimize antenna gain via electronic beam steering, minimizing aerodynamic impact. Dual-polarized antennas enhance MIMO performance by reducing interference, while beamforming algorithms like zero-forcing or minimum mean square error further improve signal-to-noise ratio and capacity.
reference_context: Antenna specifications are critical for inter-satellite communications, considering mission requirements, space environment, and cost constraints.
